dedupe_keys.name: dataset for real time hydraulic interval state estimation for water transport networks a case study

description: Stelios Vrachimis publishes an EPANET input network used in a real-time hydraulic interval state-estimation case study. Zenodo serves the INP file and a short text README under EUPL 1.1 at no cost. The network encodes water-transport assets and hydraulic settings used in the 2018 publication; the page does not name a real utility or give the network’s node count. Modellers can reuse this test network to compare interval-estimation and sensor-placement methods. The catalogue contains the general model-epanet platform, whereas this deposit is a specific network input, not EPANET itself. A limitation is that the page does not include observation series or reported calibration error, so users need the paper and file to reproduce the original experiment. Spatial extent and time step are not verified from metadata. The INP was not downloaded or run in EPANET.
